# Go Report Card

The badge and detailed analyzer report are generated by the [Go quality reports workflow](https://github.com/soulteary/owlmail/actions/workflows/go-quality-reports.yml).
Each run records the exact analyzed commit as `github.sha`; open that workflow
run and its uploaded artifact to inspect the complete findings and source revision.

This tracked page intentionally does not copy generated source line numbers,
because they become stale as code moves. Report writeback keeps the compact
SVG badge and test summaries in Git. Detailed analyzer findings stay in the
run artifact, while the required test workflows remain the authoritative merge gate.
